title: zotero-plugin-index published data
description: The file dist/v1/plugins.json that pnpm build writes: one record for each entry under plugins/.

generatedAt.description: When the build ran, as a UTC time such as 2026-10-25T06:17:00.000Z.

plugins.description: One record for each entry, sorted by id.

id.description: The entry directory name. pnpm check requires it to equal the id in the entry's meta.json; the build does not check it.

repoUrl.description: The repoUrl of the entry's meta.json.

upstream.description: The facts read from the plugin's GitHub repo, its releases, and its release XPI, after a check that its update.json lists the plugin id. Present when the read succeeds.

failure.description: Why the upstream read failed. Present when the read fails, in place of upstream.

name.description: A failure name of the reader, such as fork or no-xpi-release, or unexpected-error for an error the reader does not name.

overrides.description: The overrides of the entry's index.json, unchanged. The upstream block does not apply them.

name.description: The manifest name, with a __MSG_ name resolved.

description.description: The manifest description, with a __MSG_ name resolved.

repoUrl.description: The repo URL that GitHub returns.

openIssues.description: Open issues and pull requests in the repo.

releaseCount.description: Releases that carry an .xpi asset, drafts excluded.

latestReleaseDate.description: The publish date of the release whose manifest was read.

field.description: The upstream fact this override corrects: name, description, homepage (homepage_url in the manifest), or strict_min_version and strict_max_version, which correct the upstream strictMinVersion and strictMaxVersion.

version.description: The plugin version the override applies to. Absent means every version.

reason.description: Why the upstream value is wrong.
